25001.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 3.6 miles west of Barnstable caught 9.48 inches in September, the wettest month of the year. The biggest one-day reading came Sep 14 with 3.05 inches. The longest dry stretch ran 8 days, Aug 5 to Aug 12, with nothing in the gauge. That puts the year 7.59 inches ahead of last year at this point.
